description: Look back and ahead: recent activity, open tasks and the next seven days' events. Sequence (built in): runs these steps in one call, as you: 1. list_activity; 2. list_tasks; 3. list_events. Steps whose tool you do not have are skipped. Pass dryRun: true to see the resolved plan without running it.

calendar.description: Calendar to read events from (its URL name, see list_calendars) (default: "personal")

dryRun.description: Resolve and validate the steps, but run none
